name: Voxera
summary: Cinematic AI voice-agent landing page: a blood-red canyon photo hero with a lone figure, black and pale-grey bands, and product UI chips floating over the same red landscape.

fonts.pairing: medium grotesk headlines at -0.04em, IBM Plex Mono uppercase labels with an orange dot

signature: one red canyon photograph reused as the backdrop of every product card so UI mockups feel set inside the brand world
orange-dot mono eyebrow labels before each H2
dark translucent call-flow chips (incoming, missed, on hold) as illustrations instead of screenshots
imagery: moody red desert canyon with a tiny silhouetted figure, warm lifestyle photos for results cards, dark glassy UI chips
layout_grid: 1400px canvas, 60px side padding, 60-100px section padding, 3-column card grid, 18px radius
